description: Read text files, like cat: whole, or one slice via head, tail, or startLine/endLine. Images and audio return as media; pass binary: true to get any other binary file whole as a base64 embedded resource.

binary.description: Return a binary file that is not an image or audio whole, as a base64 embedded resource. Full reads only.

includeHash.description: Include SHA-256 hash of the returned content in the response

path.description: Single file path; mutually exclusive with paths

paths.description: Array of file paths for batch mode (max 1000); mutually exclusive with path

items.description: File or directory path inside an allowed workspace root.

name: read
title: Read File
